sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG("compliancecase"."prevviol") AS m1 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref"  GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of previous violations per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
index against the g average of average of previous violations (g level)
rank within the group by average of previous violations: index against the g average, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "trader"."tradekind" AS g, AVG("compliancecase"."modelconf") AS m1 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref" GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "trader"."tradekind"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of model confidence per transactionrecord within trader.tradekind
gap to the g average of average of model confidence (g level)
rank within the group by average of model confidence, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."trdref" AS e, "trader"."tradekind" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "transactionrecord" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref"  GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."trdref", "trader"."tradekind"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the g total of number of transactionrecord records (g level)
rank within the group by number of transactionrecord records, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" AS e, "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG("sentimentandfundamentals"."optvolrt") AS m1 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref"  GROUP BY "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of option volume vs average per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
index against the all average of average of option volume vs average (all level)
rank within the group by average of option volume vs average: index against the all average, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG("compliancecase"."fposrate") AS m1 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref"  GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of false-positive rate per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
gap to the all average of average of false-positive rate (all level)
rank within the group by average of false-positive rate: gap to the all average, keep the top 3
